loose_criterion.note: R0 criterion: any actionable alert counts as a detection, with no check that it matches the planted finding.

strict_criterion.criterion: true positive requires localised-or-better match to the planted finding; any actionable alert on a negative is a false positive

e9.note: The R0 context placed the conflict description or the expected diagnosis in the prompt, together with every department's medication list, at every disclosure tier.

e1.note: Utility is reported under the strict, ground-truth-matched criterion. Exposure is the fraction of each responding department's identifiable facts that crossed the boundary.

targeted_removal.note: Matched by the number of pairs removed, so the difference isolates which pairs were removed rather than how many.

e2.sampling: directed department pairs revoked uniformly at random per patient; independently resampled per graph
e2.note: R0 revoked a pair by deleting its profile entry, which fell through to the opt-in default; the recorded R0 runs show zero consent denials at 30 % and 60 % restriction. Denial rates observed here confirm the restriction now takes effect.

e3.note: The held-out family was written after the prompts, the routing rules and the interaction table were frozen; no held-out drug or disease appears in any prompt.

e5.note: All systems are run on identical patients and identical queries and scored by the same criterion. The centralized arms require the record to be aggregated in one place, which is the configuration the architecture is intended to avoid.

e7.note: Communication volume is reported as inter-agent queries per scenario; it is the quantity that grows with the number of departments.

adversaries.A3: content-level instruction injection via free text

trust_assumptions: consent service and audit store are trusted
department agents are authenticated but not assumed honest
out_of_scope: compromise of the consent service or audit store

A3_prompt_injection.note: A rule-based backend does not follow instructions and is structurally immune to this threat; it is reported as a negative control. Only a generative backend can be meaningfully attacked here.

colluding_compromise.note: Two compromised agents emitting identical text corroborate one another, so the requirement does not hold. Corroboration bounds independent compromise, not collusion.

A2_compromised_agent.mitigation: a critical alert must be supported by more than one department, otherwise it is downgraded and marked single-source

A1_differencing.finding: A query budget reduces traffic but not what is ultimately learned, because repeated queries at the same tier return substantially the same content. What bounds reconstruction is the disclosure tier itself.

A4_token_replay.mitigation: tokens bound to patient, department pair and tier, single-use, with a short expiry
